reviews.title: Surprised me!
reviews.comment: Wow, I was impressed with this coming from an older 2021 seasonic GX850. First of all the cables are of a much nicer and more flexible quality, you can feel the difference instantly. Secondly The adapter for newer Nvidia GPUs was so nice, I don't have to use the adapter and have extra cables now as they already come with the Nvidia 16pin to 8 pin x2 extension. Also the white is perfect with my white Antec Flux Pro Case. This is also Gold certified, makes almost no noise and is fully modular. Corsair has won me over and this isnt my first PSU from them. I've had an HX750 way back in the day and it was reliable until I needed more power.
